title: This Might Be the Most Practical AI Gadget Yet
description:
Most AI devices are trying to replace your laptop or phone.

This one takes a different approach.

It's designed around reading, note-taking, and staying in the same flow. With an e-paper display, quick note capture, Android apps, and Perplexity built in, you can read, ask questions, and save ideas without constantly switching between apps.

That's what makes this device interesting—it doesn't try to do everything. It focuses on helping you think, learn, and work with fewer interruptions.

#PerplexityAI #ProductivityTech #DeepWork #Tech #AI
